source: notebooks/accounts_payable_pipeline.ipynb (cells 10, 12, 14; validated Phase 1 entry point ingest_document; cross-checked against docs/modularisation_map.md §1.4 and §10.1)
purpose: Phase 1 ingestion parity baseline for the four controlled fixtures declared in tests/fixtures/invoices/manifest.json.
notes: Values were produced by calling the extracted ap_agent.tools.ingestion functions against the committed fixture bytes and cross-checked against the batch and document IDs recorded in docs/modularisation_map.md §10.1 (all four document IDs and the batch ID match exactly).
Phase 1's IngestionResult carries no review flag: review routing begins in Phase 4/5, so 'expected review flag' is not established at this phase and is intentionally omitted rather than guessed.
expected_document_status is always PENDING for a freshly ingested document: Phase 1 only registers identity and preserves bytes, it does not advance document.status (that happens in later phases).

expected_disposition is ACCEPTED for all four documents because the four fixtures are byte-distinct; DUPLICATE is only observed when a renamed byte-identical copy is ingested afterwards in the same known_sha256_values set (see duplicate_policy below). Renamed duplicate copies are not committed as fixtures (CLAUDE.md); tests must create them dynamically in tmp_path.

duplicate_policy.description: A renamed, byte-identical copy of an already-ingested fixture, submitted with the original's SHA-256 present in known_sha256_values, is DUPLICATE/SKIPPED and reuses the original's identity and stored artifact.
